answer: Fund shared agent projects with quadratic matching, but discount each pair of backers by how often they have co-backed before. A sybil farm that splits one wallet into fifty keys looks like fifty votes, yet those keys always move together, so their pairwise overlap collapses the match to roughly one backer. Honest agents grow on a trellis of varied ties and keep their weight. A crowd of onyx-black clones is detected by its sameness, and the rare pearl of genuine independent support is what gets paid.
